text:
incident-bot: [P1] inference-runtime-prod: spike in 5xx and P99 latency > 5s across us-west-2 cluster. Paging oncall. Links: https://alerts.redwood.internal/alert/12345

alex: got the page, I'm oncall. looking at grafana now.

maria: I see a big error_rate jump around 2026-03-15T02:07Z, looks correlated with a deploy? d5c4c3 rolled around 02:05Z.

jonah: copying logs: a bunch of `model-unavailable` + connection timeouts to kv-cache. also a handful of `async write timeout` from serve-proxy.

alex: routing policy shows some nodes flapping. autoscaler triggered scale-down at 02:03 then scale-up at 02:08, looks like thrash. probably caused transient capacity shortfall.

lee: customer impact? any 5xx to user-facing endpoints?

maria: yes, ~2% of production requests failed (top customers: search-api, chat-bot). no data loss, just increased latency and retries. PagerDuty alert has customer-impact tag.

alex: mitigation plan: 1) divert a portion of traffic to `redwood/model-fallback-v1` (lower perf but stable), 2) pause autoscaler to stop thrash, 3) mute noisy 5xx alert for 10m while we stabilize. executing now.

alex: running commands:
```
# divert 30% traffic to fallback
redwoodctl routing update --service inference-runtime-prod --policy weighted --weights "primary=70,fallback=30"
# pause autoscaler
redwoodctl autoscale pause --service inference-runtime-prod --reason "oncall mitigation"
```

incident-bot: action taken: routing updated by alex at 02:12Z; autoscaler paused.

sam: pinging infra team to check underlying node provisioning. @lee can you check node telemetry?

lee: looking at node-exporter & nvidia exporter: GPU memory pressure rose on five nodes starting 02:01Z, some OOM kills on model-worker. suspect new model variant uses larger KV cache.

jonah: confirmed deploy changed kv-cache prefetch to 2x for micro-optimizations. rolling back that flag now.

maria: rollback in progress. errors falling, p95 down from ~4.9s to 1.2s within 6m post-rollback.

alex: good. now for the after-action: we need an updated Grafana dashboard to capture this pattern and avoid noisy alerts. proposing a short dashboard for retrospectives with drilldowns.

alex: proposed panels (quick list):
- Golden signals: p50/p95/p99 latency (per-route and per-model)
- 5xx error rate and raw 5xx count (per-service, per-model)
- Autoscaler events timeline (scale-up/down, pause/resume)
- GPU memory pressure + OOM kill count (per-host)
- KV-cache miss/hit rates and prefetch volume
- Routing weights & traffic split over time
- Token throughput and cost-per-token trend (for cost correlation)
- Top 10 customers by error impact (to assess SLO exposure)

maria: nice. also add a panel for `request traces` drilldown link into tempo/jaeger for high-latency traces. and a small table with deploys + commit ids at times.

lee: for thresholds/alert tuning: current 5xx alert fires on 0.5% 5xx over 5m for whole cluster. that is too noisy when a single model spike happens. suggestions:
- move from cluster-wide to per-service/per-route alerting
- alerting rule: if error_rate_{route,model} > 0.5% AND impact_customers > 2 for 5m then page
- add adaptive mute window when autoscaler events detected in last 10m

alex: agreed. we should also create a derived metric `error_blast_radius` = count_unique(customers_with_errors)/total_customers to quantify customer impact.

sam: for grafana queries, starting points:
- error rate per model (PromQL):
```
(sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference",status=~"5..",model!=""}[5m])) by (model))
/ (sum(rate(http_requests_total{job="inference",model!=""}[5m])) by (model)) * 100
```
- p95 latency (PromQL):
```
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket{job="inference"}[5m])) by (le, model))
```
- GPU mem pressure (node exporter):
```
avg(nvidia_gpu_memory_used_bytes{} / nvidia_gpu_memory_total_bytes{}) by (instance)
```
- autoscaler events (log/metrics):
```
count_over_time(autoscaler_events_total{job="autoscaler",event=~"scale_(up|down)|paused|resumed"}[30m])
```

lee: panel drilldown suggestions: click on p95 -> open trace sample in tempo, click on model -> open logs filtered to that model, click on host -> open node exporter dashboard.

maria: owners & action items:
- maria: build the Grafana retrospective dashboard, include queries above, add deploy timeline panel. target EOD today.
- alex: update alerting rules to per-route + blast-radius gating. PR by tomorrow morning.
- sam: follow up with infra to make autoscaler behavior resilient to short-lived metric spikes.

alex: I'll also add a short runbook entry for diverting traffic and pausing autoscaler (link to playbook).

jonah: noted, will add a short incident summary to the ticket and tag affected customers for outreach.

lee: muting 5xx cluster alert for 10m now. :white_check_mark:

maria: starting dashboard build. sharing draft link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/retros/inference-incident-1923456789 (will update)

alex: thanks everyone — great handoff. follow-up retro tomorrow 10:00am PST. :thumbsup:
